values.note: Call or text (507) 221-0576, 8 AM-3:30 PM; 2027 reservations open March 15, 2027. Tent areas are first come only. Cancel 48 hours ahead for a refund less a $15 administration fee.

booking.source: reservations page ('Reservations for the 2027 camping season opens March 15, 2027. values.note: Water and electric $32 a night; 28+ consecutive nights $27 a night (call; no refunds). Tent areas $16. Card payments add 2.4% (minimum $1.50), e-check $1.50.

fees.source: pricing page ('Water & Electric ... 1 $32.00'; 'Credit Card 2.4% of amount paid -Minimum Fee $1.50'; 'E-check - flat fee $1.50'; '28+ CONSECUTIVE NIGHTS -- $27.00/NIGHT') + reservations page ('a rental rate of $16.00 per night' for tents) + FAQ ('As of January 1, 2020, daily and annual parking passes are no longer required.'), read 2026-11-11

note: Cottonwood County park on Talcot Lake off MN-62 near Dundee. The lakeside row (sites 2-22) runs along the shore on lawn with scattered trees, but most of it is seasonal: the daily rentals on it are sites 2, 3, 6 and 7. Swimming beach, three public docks, fish cleaning station and playground. --Claude
summary: County pages and map read: 64 W/E sites (30/50A), 18 daily (map numbers them), seasonal waiting list, showers, dump, laundry, May 1-Oct 31 (water off Oct 1), phone/text booking (2027 opens Mar 15), $32 (28+ nights $27), no parking pass. Lakefront kept on the lakeside row; daily lakeside sites 2, 3, 6, 7. Note cleaned.
flags: WATERFRONT lakefront kept, with a caveat in the note: the county map's lakeside row is sites 1-22 between the campground road and the Talcot Lake shore; the daily rentals on it are 2, 3, 6 and 7 (1 is the host, 4, 5 and 8-22 seasonal). On Esri z19 imagery the row's pads (about 43.8649,-95.4592 by the beach to 43.8656,-95.4603 by the middle dock) sit ~15-25 m from the riprapped shore across lawn with scattered trees, not a continuous band. The other daily rentals (36-38 by the pond, 53-65 in the south loop) are 150-350 m from the lake. Sites 2, 3, 6 and 7 are sold by the night (white 'Daily Rentals' on the map).

LONG-STAY: 18 of 64 sites daily (28%), seasonal waiting list ('There is currently a waiting list for seasonal sites'). Passes test 4 (more than 1 in 10 nightly); posted nightly rate. Not mostly seasonal in the sense of the rule, but seasonal-heavy.
PIN 43.864851,-95.460557 is on the north edge of the campground's pond, ~70 m SW of the lakeside row; under 250 m, no move needed (43.8652,-95.4598 would sit on the row).
